Reference: [Amazon S3 API operations](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/API/API_Operations_Amazon_Simple_Storage_Service.html), fetched 2026-11-08 (116 operations; the page carries no version date). The Phase 0 reconciliation of every AWS name against this table, with a reference link per operation, is `docs/reports/op-table-check-2026-11-08.md`.

The classifier is a pure, table-driven function `(method, shape, query keys, selected headers) → Operation`. Rows are walked in order and the first match wins; `OPTIONS` at any level is `Preflight`; nothing matched is `Unknown` and is still proxied and counted. `partNumber`, `versionId`, and `Range` are flags, never discriminators. `x-id` is a test oracle, never a discriminator.

**113 operations** (110 AWS names, plus `Unknown`, `Preflight`, and `PostObject`), **113 classifier rows**.
